statement: Individuals working extreme work hours lack the time needed to manually keep up with paying, tracking, and managing monthly bills.
normalized_problem: Inability to keep up with bill payments due to demanding work schedules
desired_outcome: Low-touch or automated bill management routines that take minimal time to maintain.
current_solutions: Hiring daily money managers or financial assistants
attempts: Setting up automatic payments across all accounts
solution_complaints: Hiring daily money managers can be costly
Autopay without monitoring risks overdrafts when account balances fluctuate
